title: Alfajores de Maicena
description: Crumbly cornstarch cookies sandwiched with thick dulce de leche and rolled in coconut. Makes about 24 small alfajores.
notes: They are better the next day, once the cookies have softened slightly against the filling.

steps.text: Beat the butter and caster sugar until pale, then beat in the egg yolks, vanilla, lemon zest, and brandy.
Sift in the cornstarch, flour, and baking powder and bring together into a soft dough without kneading. Wrap and chill.
steps.tip: Cornstarch has no gluten, so the dough is fragile. Chilling is what makes it possible to roll.

steps.text: Roll to 5 mm, cut 5 cm rounds, and bake until set but still pale.
steps.tip: They should not colour at all. Browned edges mean a dry cookie.

steps.text: Cool completely, then sandwich pairs with a thick layer of dulce de leche.
Roll the exposed edges in the coconut.
